facts.text: Verde Village was developed in 1970 as a retirement community, originally consisting of eight units named Verde Village Units One through Eight.
About two-thirds of Verde Village residents are retired, reflecting its original purpose as a retirement community.
Verde Village is part of the Verde Valley, which spans roughly 714 square miles in central Arizona.
The Verde River flows through the Verde Valley, providing a waterway that runs northwest to southeast across the region that includes Verde Village.
Nearly 80% of the land in the Verde Valley is National Forest, meaning most of the surrounding area around Verde Village is federally protected forest land.
The elevation of the Verde Valley ranges from 3,300 to 3,900 feet above sea level, giving Verde Village a mild climate typical of the region.
